forms.name: 联系我们
forms.form_content:
<label>您的姓名
    [text* your-name]</label>

<label>您的邮箱
    [email* your-email]</label>

<label>主题
    [text* your-subject]</label>

<label>您的留言
    [textarea your-message]</label>

[submit "发送"]

mail_template.subject: [_site_title] 联系表单: [your-subject]
mail_template.body:
姓名: [your-name]
邮箱: [your-email]
主题: [your-subject]

留言内容:
[your-message]

forms.name: 产品询价
forms.form_content:
<label>您的姓名
    [text* your-name]</label>

<label>您的邮箱
    [email* your-email]</label>

<label>您的电话
    [tel your-phone]</label>

<label>产品名称
    [text* product-name]</label>

<label>询价数量
    [number quantity min:1]</label>

<label>详细需求
    [textarea your-requirements]</label>

[submit "提交询价"]

mail_template.body:

邮箱: [your-email]
电话: [your-phone]

产品: [product-name]
数量: [quantity]

详细需求:
[your-requirements]

forms.name: 课程报名
forms.form_content:
<label>您的姓名
    [text* your-name]</label>

<label>您的邮箱
    [email* your-email]</label>

<label>您的电话
    [tel* your-phone]</label>

<label>课程名称
    [text* course-name]</label>

<label>教育背景
    [select education "高中" "大专" "本科" "硕士" "博士"]</label>

<label>其他说明
    [textarea additional-info]</label>

[submit "提交报名"]

mail_template.subject: [_site_title] 课程报名: [course-name]
mail_template.body:
学员信息:
姓名: [your-name]
邮箱: [your-email]
电话: [your-phone]
教育背景: [education]

报名课程: [course-name]

其他说明:
[additional-info]

forms.name: 反馈表单
forms.form_content:
<label>您的姓名（可选）
    [text your-name]</label>

<label>您的邮箱（可选）
    [email your-email]</label>

<label>反馈类型
    [select feedback-type "建议" "投诉" "咨询" "其他"]</label>

<label>满意度评分
    [select rating "非常满意" "满意" "一般" "不满意" "非常不满意"]</label>

<label>详细反馈
    [textarea* your-feedback]</label>

[submit "提交反馈"]

mail_template.subject: [_site_title] 用户反馈: [feedback-type]
mail_template.body:
反馈人: [your-name]
邮箱: [your-email]

反馈类型: [feedback-type]
满意度: [rating]

详细反馈:
[your-feedback]
